context: This criteria evaluates the correct usage of agents to maintain persistent cookie jars across multiple requests.

checklist.name: Agent creation
checklist.description: Creates an agent instance using the agent() factory function to enable cookie persistence

checklist.name: Request through agent
checklist.description: Makes requests through the agent instance rather than directly on the main module

checklist.name: Cookie persistence
checklist.description: Demonstrates that cookies are automatically saved from responses and sent with subsequent requests through the same agent
